selected_experiment.question: Can the semantically verified exact-identity localdef WHNF cache become economically active if restricted to the already-verified Nat.succ_le_succ hotspot?
selected_experiment.candidate: Enable the exact expression × active-context × universe-params identity cache only while currentDeclaration is Nat.succ_le_succ.
selected_experiment.promotion_rule: Promote economically only if scoped-cache total wall time is strictly below the paired cold total, all semantic statuses match cold, no REJECT is introduced, restart reproduces, and ablation restores cold behavior.

post_result_reclosure.if_economic_win: promote scoped cache to ACTIVE, emit PREFERENCE_CHANGE/PROMOTED_CAPABILITY event, remove the promote-cache acquisition route, reclose and rerank all live frontiers
post_result_reclosure.if_no_economic_win: retain semantic capability in RESERVE, compile economic obstruction against this realization, remove only this realization route, reclose and rerank all live frontiers

claim_boundary: This precommit freezes the selected experiment and promotion rule before the scoped-cache target run. It does not predict the outcome or authorize any new Lean semantic rule.
